model.name: No live prompt/keystroke injection between agents
model.description: No agent writes to another agent's stdin / prompt / keystroke buffer to communicate; ALL agent-to-agent communication goes via AgentMessage units + the mailbox pull. A by-construction guard flags any tmux send-keys / stdin-write to a peer agent pane used for messaging (only the mailbox is the sanctioned path). This makes live-prompt-injection - the source of this session's sent-!=-delivered + capture-pane-verify workarounds - impossible.

discoverySource.note: Tron-authorized S30. structural fix for the sent-!=-delivered pattern (this session's keystroke-into-busy-pane failures: messages queued in an agent's input buffer, Enter never submitted, capture-pane workarounds).

acceptanceCriteria.text: No agent writes to another agent's stdin / prompt / keystroke buffer to communicate; all agent-to-agent comms go via AgentMessage units + the mailbox pull.

A by-construction guard (lint/audit) flags any tmux send-keys / stdin-write to a peer AGENT pane used for messaging - only the mailbox is the sanctioned path (agent panes, not the interactive server TUI which is R29.1).
A message delivered while the recipient is mid-turn is NOT injected into its prompt; it waits for the pull. No keystroke-into-busy-pane path remains for agent messaging.

model.crossRefNote: Structural fix for the sent-!=-delivered / keystroke-injection failure hit repeatedly this session; R30.3 no-injection guard enforces R30.2 async mailbox by construction.
